About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Surrey should I look at for condos?

The main pockets are Cloverdale, Fleetwood, Guildford, Newton, Panorama Ridge, Sullivan Heights, Clayton and South Surrey. Each has a different mix of lot sizes, age of homes and price points, so I match the area to your budget and commute.
What schools serve Surrey?
Homes here are in Surrey School District 36. Catchments are set by address, so confirm the specific school with the district before you buy.
How is transit and commuting from Surrey?
Options include SkyTrain Expo Line (King George to Scott Road), the coming Surrey Langley SkyTrain along Fraser Hwy, and RapidBus R1/R6.
What zoning rules affect condos in Surrey?
Most detached lots are RF/RF-13/RF-10 (now being folded into the R-zones of the new Surrey Zoning Bylaw), and Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing allows up to 3-4 units on many lots.
What should I check before buying a condo in Surrey?
Strata title: check the depreciation report, contingency fund, bylaws on rentals and pets, and any special levies. I review documents with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Surrey?
Yes, qualifying buyers can use the BC First-Time Home Buyers' property transfer tax exemption and the federal FHSA. See my first-time buyer guide for current thresholds.

I've been named a Top 35 Under 35 and Top 10 RLP in BC, with Diamond and Hall of Fame awards and a 5.0 client rating. I grew up on a farm in Langley and I'm back living here now.
